code:
all: reducer

reducer: parser.y lexer.l term.h
	bison -d parser.y
	flex lexer.l
	gcc parser.tab.c lex.yy.c -o reducer

clean:
	rm -f parser.tab.c parser.tab.h lex.yy.c reducer
description: A Makefile that runs Bison and Flex, compiles the generated C with gcc, and cleans the generated files and the binary.

steps.description: This is the `Makefile`. The page says to save it with a tab at the start of each command line. It builds the reducer from the Flex and Bison sources.
`all` depends on `reducer`, and `reducer` depends on `parser.y`, `lexer.l`, and `term.h`.
The recipe runs `bison -d parser.y`, then `flex lexer.l`, then `gcc parser.tab.c lex.yy.c -o reducer`. `bison -d` also writes the header `parser.tab.h`, and `flex` writes `lex.yy.c`.
`clean` removes the generated files and the binary: `parser.tab.c`, `parser.tab.h`, `lex.yy.c`, and `reducer`.

title: The Makefile
